span.p:
Public surface
/health · /api/diag/smoke · /diag · /auth/*
POST /api/duels/{id}/local-result
GET /api/models/download-status/{id}
static assets + SPA fallback
(dev only) /openapi · /scalar · /api/dev/*

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Handler runs.
IdentityResolver stamps preferred_username onto
Duel.OwnerId / Duel.VerdictBy — forensic only,
never used for an authorization decision.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Features:AllowAnonymousWrites
AND a duel write endpoint?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
401 Unauthorized
(cookie events rewrite the 302 so an API caller never gets HTML)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Roles are issued (Guest via /auth/login/fake,
X-Fake-Roles in tests) and surfaced by /auth/me,
but NO endpoint or page requires one.
Authorization is binary: authenticated or not.
